hamburg-altes-land-and-elbe-orchard-ride.title: Hamburg · Altes Land and Elbe Orchard Ride
hamburg-altes-land-and-elbe-orchard-ride.slogan: A 123 km loop out of Finkenwerder ferry feel
hamburg-altes-land-and-elbe-orchard-ride.story: Ferry air, fruit villages and empty-dike calm when timed right. Out of Ottensen and back again: 123 km, roughly 2 h 07 in the saddle. On the way it passes Jork orchard roads, Stade old town and Zollenspieker dike stop. Back roads rather than main roads, where the map allows.
